data.value: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?

Kestrel Analytics is considering a proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office. The landlord has offered six months rent-free. The option to sign expires next Friday at 5pm. Headcount plans were cut 20% last quarter and half the team is remote. The CFO has privately told the CEO she prefers a shorter term.
